name: Iveri: The 1.000 Story
source:
“Iveri: The 1.000 Story” is a brief and very-to-the-point story about a woman (default name Iveri) who volunteer to be the next sacrifice to protect her village from demonic attacks.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1192050/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《伊维里：一千人的故事》是一个简短而切中要害的故事，讲述了一名妇女（默认名字伊维里）自愿成为下一个牺牲品，以保护她的村庄免受恶魔袭击。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1192050/]Steam[/url]]
